purpose: Teach: 消す/素早く/ニコニコ/いやあ/真っ黒/鞄/懐かしく/セーター

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、本気で、絶対、ライト、絶対、消す、絶対、時間、絶対、もうすぐよ
lines.en: Sho, it's almost time for Mei's shop lights to go off.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Gentle on the opening name. Steady pace, no rush—just a kindly reminder she's made a thousand times before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、素早く、絶対、お片づけ、絶対、できたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I finished tidying up really fast!
lines.style: Small boy's quick, proud delivery. Slight breathlessness—he's been moving fast and wants her to notice the effort. Open, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ニコニコ、絶対、嬉しいわ
lines.en: Sho, that makes Mei so happy.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. A smile that reaches her eyes even though he can only hear it. Slow, unhurried—savoring the moment of him trying so hard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いやあ、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、今日は、絶対、楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, today was so much fun!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. The words tumble out with genuine delight. Quick pace, no self-consciousness. A small child's pure excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、髪、絶対、真っ黒、絶対、艶やかね
lines.en: Your hair is so beautifully dark and shiny, Sho.
lines.style: Noticing something true and small about him. Tender observation—not fussing, just seeing. Quiet admiration in the cadence, the kind that makes a child stand a little taller.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、鞄、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、買ってくれたよ
lines.en: My dad bought me this bag, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Casual pride in a small possession. Matter-of-fact delivery with a thread of warmth—he's thinking of his dad in a good way. No performance, just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、おばあちゃんの、絶対、お話、絶対、懐かしく、絶対、思い出すわ
lines.en: Your grandmother's stories remind me of so many things, Sho.
lines.style: A moment of drift into memory. Slower, more contemplative. Gentle nostalgia—not sad, but distant for a moment. Her voice softens on the word 'grandmother.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、セーター、絶対、おばあちゃん、絶対、編んでくれたんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my grandmother knitted this sweater for me.
lines.style: Soft pride in something handmade. A small boy's careful way of sharing something precious. Slow enough to let the gift land—not rushed, but not heavy either.
